question:
Simplify

 [6-2left{3-4(4div (1)/(4)-1)+2div (1)/(3)right}-3times 2]
solution:
**Given:**

[6-2{3-4(4div (1)/(4)-1)+2div (1)/(3)}-3times 2]

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

⇒ [6-2{3-4(4times 4-1)+2times 3}-6]

⇒ [6-2{3-4(15)+6}-6]

⇒ [6-2{3-60+6}-6]

⇒ [6-2{-51}-6]

⇒ [6+102-6]

⇒ 102

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
